About TRON

TRON is a layer-1 blockchain known for low-fee transfers and is one of the largest networks for USDT stablecoin payments. TRX pays for network resources and is used for staking and governance.

Where this TRX price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Binance (TRX/USDT) and Kraken (TRX/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 94.67B TRX (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
